design.stage: EAB round 3, step 2: does private verification separate good from poor teacher content? Confirmation of the gated selection rule on new independent cohorts.
design.question: With the frozen gated rule as candidate and the within-budget public portfolio as comparator, does total-budget private verification accept on MNIST (good teacher) and reject on Usenet (poor teacher content)?
design.prior_knowledge_disclosed: The designers have seen all existing records: the old-cohort selection-rule study (release-eab2-20261020), and old-cohort test metrics showing protected centered naming above the LOO public portfolio on MNIST/CIFAR-10k and below it on Usenet (full naming budget). The predictions below are therefore informed; the new evidence is the protected verification on new cohorts.
design.composition: naming, gain and class releases composed sequentially into one total (epsilon, delta) per deployment, although naming and validation clients are disjoint; no parallel-composition credit is claimed

cohorts.images: naming clients: 600 records with replacement under Dirichlet alpha=.1 from the TRAINING source pool; validation clients: a disjoint set of n constructed clients, 120 records each with replacement under their own Dirichlet alpha=.1 proportions from the HELD-OUT source pool; pools = stratified 80/20 split of the private pool, seed 2026101901 (the CIFAR-1k verification split rule, applied per task)
cohorts.usenet: naming clients: 3000 From-header authors drawn without replacement from the 4249 eligible authors (cohort seed); validation clients: the remaining 1249 authors with all their posts
cohorts.client_unit: a complete client dataset; naming and validation clients are different clients

teacher.model: linear softmax head on the frozen 128-d features
teacher.naming: K=C public partition, M votes, one protected aggregate at rho fraction .5, centered and coverage decoders as in release-frontier-20261019

label_draws.draws: the 100 existing random draws per task listed in tasks.label_draw_source; public learner outputs reused and asserted equal on test
label_draws.reason: draws 50-99 were never used to select the gated rule; draws 0-49 selected it on old cohorts

candidate.rule: cover-noise-0.03 (frozen in release-eab2-20261020): if the m=C labels miss a class and the naming noise std v <= 0.03, the protected centered naming; otherwise exact LOO over the frozen family (14 public learners, 8 joint weights, private centered and coverage)
candidate.v: residual_std of the naming certificate at rho fraction .5 (public function of n, epsilon, K)

design.comparator: the LOO-selected public portfolio on the same m=C labels (deployable public fallback); its predictions on validation records are the same public models queried inductively

validation.gain_report: per-client held-out accuracy difference d_i=u_i(f)-u_i(b) in [-1,1], report round half-up s(1+d_i)/2, s=2^16, integer sensitivity s
validation.class_report: C x 4 joint correctness histogram per client normalized by its record count, exact largest-remainder integer simplex, squared sensitivity 2 s^2
validation.gain_lower: released gain - 2 v_g sqrt(2 log(1/alpha)) - 1/s, alpha=.025
validation.class_bands: direct linear-sum bands of release-value-20261019/linear_bands.py, alpha=.025
validation.noise: independent exact distributed discrete Gaussian shares; deterministic research keys

policies.gated_gain_verified: publish the gated candidate iff it uses private votes and gain lower > 0, else b
policies.gated_class_verified: additionally every class recall lower > 0, else b

primary.cases: cases whose gated candidate uses private votes
primary.informativeness: expected Usenet gain band radius at epsilon=1 is recorded below (must be < .10 for the test to be informative)

predictions: test utility of gated_gain_verified minus LOO > 0 on MNIST and >= 0 on Usenet at epsilon=1 (verification removes the gate loss on Usenet)
new cohorts reproduce the gate direction at epsilon=1: gated above LOO on MNIST, below LOO on Usenet
at epsilon=.1 the gate is closed on all three tasks (v > .03), so the candidate is the LOO choice

reporting.utility: task metric on test (balanced accuracy for Usenet, accuracy otherwise) and both metrics for all tasks; mean over cohorts x draws
reporting.intervals: crossed bootstrap over cohorts x label draws, 2000 replicates, seed 20261022
reporting.offline_diagnostics: clean held-out gain and recalls from unreleased counts; false accepts; test labels loaded only after all decisions
reporting.amendments: any implementation fix made after this freeze is logged in AMENDMENTS.json with time and reason; none may depend on primary outcomes
